source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Μάρτυρας και οι συν αυτώ Φιλίππα, Διόσκορος, Σωκράτης και Διονύσιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page gives the company no years of its own: it sets Theodore and Dioscorus in the reign of the emperor Antoninus, which it dates 138 to 161 in one sentence and 138 to 160 in the next, and it names a governor Theodotus, so no `dates` were taken. Five people are named and enumerated on the page — Theodore, his mother Philippa, Dioscorus, and the two soldiers Socrates and Dionysius — and this corpus makes one folder for each. Theodore already had one: the corpus keeps him as theodore-of-perga, off the Romanian calendar's 21 aprilie, where doxologia.ro prints no life for him at all, so his Greek row is an upgrade on that folder and not a sixth arrival here. The corpus's four unnamed Martyrs of Perge, kept on 31 August, are a different entry and are not these. The page prints no hymn for the company.
